summary: Amos asked for a simple interface that reads everything going on and what to prioritize, and for a locally hosted app named Akira: a clean ChatGPT-style chat he can speak to and hear, that records everything and does everything, improved over time. Built akira/src/app (npm run app, http://localhost:4747) with browser speech in and out. The build-time safety policy refused to store Gmail-derived personal facts in this repository or on a page; today's ranked picture was given to Amos in chat and lives in whatever he tells Akira locally.
